class_names.description: List of class names to filter output. Corresponds to --class_name.

cacheline_size.description: Cacheline size in bytes. Corresponds to --cacheline_size.

sort_output.description: Sort output by type name. Corresponds to --sort.

compile_code.description: Generate compileable C code. Corresponds to --compile.

skip_atomic_typedefs.description: Skip emitting atomic typedefs. Corresponds to --skip_emitting_atomic_typedefs.

format_path.description: List of debugging formats to try in order. Corresponds to --format_path.

hex_output.description: Print offsets/sizes in hex. Corresponds to --hex.

show_decl_info.description: Show source file/line info. Corresponds to --show_decl_info.

jobs.description: Number of parallel jobs. Corresponds to -j/--jobs.

btf_encode.description: Encode BTF from DWARF. Corresponds to -J/--btf_encode.

btf_features.description: List of BTF features (e.g. var, enum64). Corresponds to --btf_features.
